content: Best practices: auto-lock after inactivity period; clipboard auto-clear after 20-30s (many managers like Bitwarden/Keeper default to never clearing, which is a known weak default worth avoiding); breach monitoring against known-breach databases; generator producing 16-20+ char passwords with mixed character classes; master password should be long passphrase (20-24 chars or 4-6 words) not a memorized short password.
